content.short: Rubic is a cross-chain swap aggregator and best-rate finder for trading assets across many networks.
content.description: Rubic is a decentralized cross-chain and on-chain swap aggregator that searches across DEXs, bridges, intent protocols, and other liquidity sources to find efficient routes for token trades. Its documentation describes support for dozens of blockchains, a large token universe, and a best-rate finder designed to remove the manual work of comparing bridges and exchanges. Rubic keeps swaps non-custodial and provides SDK tooling for apps that want to add cross-chain trading. For Mantle users, Rubic helps route assets into, out of, and across the ecosystem.
content.meta: Rubic aggregates DEXs and bridges for cross-chain and on-chain swaps. Discover Rubic on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
